visual_language.name: Working elegance of the service
visual_language.palette: ivory, sand, clay, brass, moss, volcanic ink, Pacific dusk blue
visual_language.light: HST real hours — overcast trade-wind, dusk lānai, Kohala hard sun, Kauaʻi mountain shade. No teal-orange grade.
visual_language.hawaii_via: lava stone, koa/monkeypod wood, trade-wind lānai, island-specific coast/mountain, edible local fish and fruit — never lei, tiki, hula, surfboard props
visual_language.people: working chefs, candid guests; no theatrical toque; no named real chefs

island_visual_ids.oahu: Gold Coast / Ko Olina residences, high-rise freight kitchens, windward beach houses, Honolulu corridor light
island_visual_ids.maui: Wailea–Makena resort villas, West Maui lanais, Haleakalā upcountry cool air, Molokini/Kahoʻolawe as distant south-shore context only
island_visual_ids.kauai: overcast North Shore mountains, Hanalei weather, Poʻipū drier south, quieter inquiry mood
island_visual_ids.bigisland: Kohala lava + white sand, Mauna Lani-type villa, Kona coffee country, whole fish on volcanic stone — not Hilo rainforest on west-side pages
